verdict.rationale:
Cal.com's v2 API and hosted MCP server together document the full agent workflow: querying available slots (docs-2/23/38), creating bookings (docs-1/37), rescheduling (docs-3/24/39), and webhook triggers show BOOKING_CANCELLED events (docs-5/26/42) alongside an explicit agents.md guide (docs-12/17/31/45/46) and a live, runtime-verified MCP server (cal-com-probe-rt-1) enabling natural-language booking management without a dashboard (docs-30). The public booking endpoint requiring no auth further supports autonomous agent booking (docs-46).
missing for 10: an explicit first-party 'cancel a booking' endpoint doc (only inferred via webhook triggers) and independent/hands-on confirmation that an agent can complete the full cycle end-to-end via MCP.
